directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the Electric 10 Series Concrete Pump in Xingtai with Dimensions (L×W×H) is 1800 × 800 × 1200 mm. Main-unit weight is is 400 kg. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Technical_drawing.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把电动10系列混凝土泵写成：外形尺寸是1800 × 800 × 1200 mm。理论输送量是21 m³/h，最大出口压力是23 MPa。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Technical_drawing。

body.en: Downloaded from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Technical_drawing. The image subject is AcotacionTecnico. Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the Electric 10 Series Concrete Pump in Xingtai with Dimensions (L×W×H) is 1800 × 800 × 1200 mm. The frame “Road roller” shows Construction site near Yass site cleared and bull dozed cleared steam roller in background and is not a site measurement of this model. Distance entries, where the sheet lists them, keep their own labels. Max. Outlet Pressure is 23 MPa. None of these is a price, a service life or a country list.
body.zh: 此图下载自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Technical_drawing。画面内容是AcotacionTecnico。河北品锦机械在邢台把电动10系列混凝土泵写成：外形尺寸是1800 × 800 × 1200 mm。目录如果另标出了距离格，那些格仍用自己的标题。

body.en: Main-unit weight is is 400 kg. Dimensions (L×W×H) is 1800 × 800 × 1200 mm. Subject: Construction site near Yass site cleared and bull dozed cleared steam roller in background. Hopper capacity is 0.1 m³.
body.zh: 理论输送量是21 m³/h，最大出口压力是23 MPa。主体：Construction site near Yass site cleared and bull dozed cleared steam 压路机 in background。

body.en: Those figures describe the machine body, not the pipeline. Main-unit weight is is 400 kg. A wider-looking machine in a frame is not a higher Theoretical Output. Maximum aggregate size is 2 cm and below.
body.zh: 画面「Road roller」的主体是Construction site near Yass site cleared and bull dozed cleared steam 压路机 in background，不是这个型号的工地实测。画面里机器看起来更宽，并不等于理论输送量更高。

body.en: Theoretical Output is 21 m³/h and Max. Outlet Pressure is 23 MPa. Millimetres and kilograms do not become metres of pipeline. The shown output stays 21 m³/h. Main-unit weight is 400 kg.
body.zh: 外形尺寸是1800 × 800 × 1200 mm。最大骨料粒径 2 cm and below。

question.en: On this row: Is that the pumping distance?

answer.en: No. Frame figures are body size or mass, not pipeline metres. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Technical_drawing.
answer.zh: 不是。外形数字是机身尺寸或质量，不是管路米数。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Technical_drawing画面里印出的数字。

answer.en: 21 m³/h. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Technical_drawing.
